concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-standard-integration-hosted-checkout-tokenization]] — 2026-09-15 Standard Hosted Checkout CardOnFile token creation and shopper-initiated reuse guide, including consent, lifecycle-webhook token receipt, zero-value limits and an unresolved Ecommerce-versus-ContAuth one-click example conflict.
warnings: The one-click parameter table instructs shopperInteraction Ecommerce at raw line 190, while the example request sends ContAuth at line 216; retain the conflict and do not infer the universally correct value.
The guide's enabled storage mode omits a Hosted Checkout checkbox, but raw line 108 separately instructs merchant to ask shopper consent before payment.
Provider SAQ A wording is not a merchant-specific PCI assessment.
